intro: Major Mattingly is a seasoned officer of the Stormwind Army stationed at the grand gates in the Valley of Heroes. Serving under General Marcus Jonathan, he assists in safeguarding the capital's main entrance and advising capable crafters on protecting heroes against draconic threats.

p: Standing watch in the Valley of Heroes, Major Mattingly is one of the high-ranking officers directly responsible for Stormwind City's primary landward defense. A grizzled veteran soldier whose face bears the lines of hard-won experience, he serves under General Marcus Jonathan alongside the city's standing garrison. Beyond his daily duties overseeing gate patrols and incoming travelers, Mattingly possesses specialized tactical knowledge regarding the lethal nature of dragons. He is recognized by seasoned adventurers as a vital contact when learning to craft protective dragonscale gear necessary for braving the realm's deadliest lairs.
